title: Nocturnal enuresis and maxillary expansion
html: Nocturnal enuresis (NE) may occur in children experiencing poor sleep secondary to an underlying sleep disorder such as obstructive sleep apnea. A causal link between an underlying sleep disorder and NE has been suggested. Maxillary expansion has been proposed to improve nasal airway patency and airflow, with the aim of reducing or resolving NE in affected children.
